19653.d: The Temple of Saradomin, or Paterdomus (Latin for "the home of the father"), is a large temple located on the River Salve, the border between the nations of Misthalin and Morytania.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Dungeoneering cape teleport to the Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon. Run south and then west. Climb the broken statue to Paterdomus.
• Ring of slaying (or ring of slaying (c)) teleport to the Slayer Tower. Run south and then west. Climb the broken statue.
• Fairy ring CKS to just west of Canifis. Run west and climb the broken statue.
• Invitation box to the Empyrean Citadel, then clicking it again to teleport to Silvarea. Run east. Requires partial completion of the quest Missing, Presumed Death.
• Skeletal horror Teleport also takes user just west of the Paterdomus.
• Fort Forinthry lodestone. Run south and then east.
• Earth altar teleport to earth altar then run north-east.

19755.d: The Penguin agility course is located on the Iceberg, and requires an Agility level of 30.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Talk to Larry, who is stationed by his boat to the north-east of Rellekka on the pier (outside the fence area).
• After starting Hunt for Red Raktuber, Larry gives players the ability to use the boat for themselves to get to the Iceberg.

Once on the Iceberg, select the "Tuxedo-time" option on Jim (polar bear to the north east) with a clockwork suit in the backpack. Head west along the ice wall and investigate avalanche. Once inside the penguin outpost, open the first door on the west. Go through the first room and head down a long passage north. Open the large door.
